author: Chase Davis
title: Beck Way nabs win in short outing
desc: Beck Way threw 10 pitches over 0.2 scoreless innings in Tuesday's win over the Mets to earn the victory.
impact: After Tuesday's win over the Mets, Way now has a 3.06 ERA and 1.53 WHIP with a 1-0 record, 8.7 K/9, and one hold in 14 appearances this season.

author: Nate Miller
title: Josh Jung (knee) remains out of the lineup Wednesday
desc: Josh Jung (knee) is once again out of the Rangers' starting lineup Wednesday.
impact: Jung last played on Saturday, as he continues to be slowed by a knee issue. The Texas third baseman has reported feeling better the past couple of days, but the club will keep him out of the starting lineup at least one more day.

author: Chase Davis
title: Seth Lugo gets shelled early but escapes with no-decision
desc: Seth Lugo allowed nine runs (six earned) on nine hits and two walks while striking out four over 4.1 innings in Tuesday's win over the Mets.
impact: After the no-decision, Lugo now owns a 4.56 ERA and 1.43 WHIP with a 3-6 record through 18 starts. He allowed seven hard hits, including two homers, and picked up six whiffs on 94 pitches. His last start of the first half comes Sunday against the Orioles.

author: Chase Davis
title: Jordan Walker homers in doubleheader
desc: Jordan Walker went 3-for-8 with a homer, two runs scored and two RBI in the doubleheader against the Brewers.
impact: Walker homered in game one before picking up two more hits on four hard-hit balls in game two. After Tuesday's doubleheader, he's batting .292 with 21 home runs, 69 RBI, 56 runs scored and 11 stolen bases across 88 games. He's had a phenomenal first half.

author: Chase Davis
title: Ivan Herrera pops homer in game one of doubleheader
desc: Ivan Herrera went 2-for-6 with a homer, one run scored and one RBI in Tuesday's doubleheader against the Brewers.
impact: Herrera picked up both of his hits in game one, but didn't strike out all day. After Tuesday's losses to Milwaukee, he is batting .254 with 11 home runs, 40 RBI, 59 runs scored, five stolen bases through 90 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Velazquez pops homer in lopsided loss
desc: Nelson Velazquez went 1-for-5 in the doubleheader against the Brewers with a home run, one run scored and two RBI.
impact: Velazquez did all his damage in the second game after getting just one pinch-hit appearance in game one's loss. Through 22 games, he's batting .269 with four homers, 12 RBI, 10 runs scored, a .385 wOBA and a 20% strikeout rate.

author: Chase Davis
title: Hunter Dobbins battles command, takes loss vs. Milwaukee
desc: Hunter Dobbins allowed three earned runs on four hits and three walks while striking out four over five innings in Tuesday's loss to Milwaukee.
impact: After the outing, Dobbins now has a 4.03 ERA and 1.39 WHIP with a 1-1 record through three starts. He was called up from Triple-A to help out during the doubleheader, but was sent back down on Wednesday.

author: Chase Davis
title: Matt Svanson whiffs one in opener appearance
desc: Matt Svanson allowed no runs on one hit while striking out one in an inning of work in Tuesday's game one of the doubleheader against the Brewers.
impact: Serving as the opener, Svanson needed only 14 pitches to get three outs. On the season, he has a 6.52 ERA, 1.66 WHIP, 9.1 K/9, one hold and two blown saves.

author: Chase Davis
title: Alex Freeland chips in three hits, steal in narrow loss
desc: Alex Freeland went 3-for-4 with a run scored, an RBI and a stolen base.
impact: After Tuesday's loss to Colorado, Freeland is slashing .237/.316/.321 with three homers, 24 runs scored, 19 RBI, two steals, and a .290 wOBA across 67 games. He's got even more competition at second base with Tommy Edman healthy and off to a scorching start.

author: Chase Davis
title: Tommy Edman swipes a bag in his return to lineup
desc: Tommy Edman went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Rockies with a run scored and one stolen base.
impact: After Tuesday's loss to Colorado, Edman is batting .340 with one home run, nine RBI, seven runs scored and two steals across 18 games. He was out of the lineup the last two games, but appeared as a pinch hitter before being back in the starting nine on Tuesday. He picked up his second steal of the season and seems to be over the ankle issue. Over his past four starts, he has two steals and one caught stealing. The caught stealing isn't concerning in the least bit, but it's good to see him being aggressive.

author: Chase Davis
title: Justin Wrobleski ends first half on a high note, but gets no help
desc: Justin Wrobleski allowed one earned run on six hits and two walks while striking out nine over seven innings in Tuesday's loss to the Rockies.
impact: After the defeat, Wrobleski now owns a 2.69 ERA and 1.02 WHIP with a 10-2 record across 15 starts. He allowed only two hard hits and picked up 13 whiffs on 94 pitches. He ends his first half tied for the league lead in wins with the second-fewest losses of qualified starters.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Alejandro Osuna homers in win over Angels
desc: Alejandro Osuna went 1-for-3 in a win over the Angels with a home run, one walk, two runs scored, and three RBI.
impact: Osuna continues a productive stretch at the plate, picking up hits in nine of his last 14 contests. The outfielder remains one of many inconsistent options in the Rangers lineup for manager Skip Schumaker, batting .252 with one home run, 18 RBI, 20 runs scored, and four stolen bases across 57 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Justin Foscue goes yard in win over Angels
desc: Justin Foscue went 2-for-2 in a win over the Angels with a home run, two runs scored, and two RBI.
impact: Foscue has heated up at the plate of late, picking up hits in four of his last six contests. The 27-year-old has provided manager Skip Schumaker with one of the more explosive bats in a streaky Rangers lineup, posting an .892 OPS with six home runs, 17 RBI, and 14 runs scored across 41 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kodai Senga struggles with command in loss to Royals
desc: Kodai Senga allowed four earned runs on five hits and four walks while striking out four over three innings in Tuesday's loss to the Royals.
impact: Senga continues an underwhelming stretch on the mound of late, allowing three earned runs or more in six of his last eight trips to the mound. The right-hander remains another dismal option in the Mets rotation, posting an 8.92 ERA and 1.80 WHIP with an 0-7 record and 1.7 K/BB ratio through 10 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Carson Benge steals base in loss to Royals
desc: Carson Benge went 2-for-3 in Tuesday's 16-12 loss to the Royals with two walks, two runs scored, one RBI, and one stolen base.
impact: Benge continues a dynamic stretch of late, getting on base in 18 of his last 19 contests. The outfielder continues to offer fantasy managers one of the more impactful bats in an underwhelming Mets lineup, hitting .262 with 11 homers, 36 RBI, 49 runs scored, and 12 stolen bases across 89 games.
